scripts.ui:build: bash scripts/build-css.sh && pnpm exec bun build src/ui/index.tsx --target browser --outdir out --sourcemap=external --minify --entry-naming bundle.[ext] --asset-naming bundle.[ext]
scripts.ui:watch: bash scripts/build-css.sh && pnpm exec bun build src/ui/index.tsx --target browser --outdir out --sourcemap=external --entry-naming bundle.[ext] --asset-naming bundle.[ext] --watch
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm exec bun test test/unit/ test/integration/ && pnpm exec playwright install chromium && pnpm exec playwright test
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run build && pnpm exec bun test test/integration/
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build && pnpm exec playwright install chromium && pnpm exec playwright test
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && rm -rf ~/bin/cortex && cp bin/cortex ~/bin/
scripts.style: bash scripts/build-repo-map.sh && node node_modules/@biomejs/biome/bin/biome check --error-on-warnings --write . && pnpm exec tsc
scripts.style:check: node node_modules/@biomejs/biome/bin/biome check --error-on-warnings . && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm exec bun scripts/check-agents.ts
